balls.text: Another yorker nailed, SKY is beaten on the reverse paddle. The 135ks ball hits him in front of middle. MI do review but it'll be immaterial. Back foot was inside the crease, it hit him on the show. Hawk-Eye predicts umpire's call, clipping off
SKY does make room this time but Arshdeep nails his length. Yorker on leg. Square driven along the ground through deep point
Yorker at 136ks on middle, SKY slides leg side but can't make enough room to lift it over mid-on. Says no to a potential tight single
Makes room and gets a 136ks full ball following him, gets beaten on the lofted on-drive. Hits pad and falls forward
Slow and short at the body, pulled to deep midwicket

Dhir's cameo ends as he finds deep backward square on the pull. Long boundary there. Was a slow, short ball around rib-height, Dhir was early into the shout and had to reach out last minute to try and impart power. Got a top edge
Middles the slog sweep to a 140ks low full toss on sixth, gets it flat and to the right of mid-on
Mid-on being in saves SKY this time, doesn't middle it but clears him and gets to fifty. Was a full ball on fifth, SKY went across and swiped low, wanted to go squarer

Wide yorker turns into a shin-high full toss on fifth, SKY forces it over the bowler with a horizontal swipe. Off the toe but cleared the infield. Mid-on was in, long-off was back, too straight for both
Pace-on. Goes for the wide yorker, gets the fully real low. Naman manages to whisk it to long-on. Off the toe
Middled this time. Pulls it from around waist-height, 75 metres over midwicket. Pace-on on a shortish length at the body

High ball teases long-off before clearing him. Shreyas there. Well over him in the end. Ball was fullish and wide, Naman launched it with a horizontal bat, bat face opened upon impact but didn't matter

Wadhera at mid-on drops a regulation chance. He took a couple of steps to the right and tried to take it around knee-height. Ball popped right off the cupped hands. Was a shortish ball outside off that SKY pulled
Full on fourth, whipped off the inside-half again. Bat face turns inward. MI wanted two but deep square swooped in
Into the pitch, at the body, 114ks. Pulled to deep square leg's left
Full on middle and leg, 131ks, SKY flicks off the inside-half of the bat to long-on
Slow on fifth on a head of length. Legcutter. Does deviate away a bit, cut to deep point
Full and wide, SKY reaches out a touch too early and has to check his scything shot. Finds cover
Slow and fullish outside off, tapped to cover's left. Stopped with a dive. Almost all balls that over were slow
Waits for the shortish ball to pass him and bunts it over backward point. Deep third has to hurry to the right, slides close to the boundary and saves two. Vyshak there
Slow again, on a length and close to the tramline. Tries to run it to third, misses
Shortish and slow over fourth, tapped on its head. Goes to short third

Hardik in disbelief after nicking off. Clear plan from PBKS considering how wide Inglis was standing. A cutter on a length landing around fifth and angling away sharply. Hardik hopped across and almost swung his shoulders off trying to cut it, got a floaty edge to Inglis' right

Another boundary firs ball of the over, this is way over deep square leg. Got a length ball at the body, he stood mostly upright and swung across the line. Close to the toe but it still sails 83 metres far
Length on middle, 129ks, Hardik backs away late and dabs it to deep third
Pace-on yorker on leg, jammed to long-on
Slower one's wide and in the slot, SKY walks into the off drive and clears the long-off boundary. 75-metre six. A boundary after a while for him
Fullish on off, defended towards mid-on. Off the inside half

This time Jamieson goes short and follows Hardik as he makes room. Pacy too, rose off the pitch without losing the zip. Hardik got cramped and his hands were close to his chest as he was withdrawing from the cut. Got hit on the glove

Edge goes through where first slip would've been. Clear intent to go big early in the over from Hardik. Dances down and makes room, isn't to the pitch of the fullish ball angling in towards middle. Tries to whack it over long-on, shaves it off a thin edge
Length on off, guided to point
Hardik lets the ball hit bat and fly over short third. The bat stopped behind his shoulder and he then ramped the bouncer off the middle
Length on fourth, skiddy, guided to backward point. 137ks
Yorker on middle, jammed to deep point

Jamieson runs right and slides at deep fine leg to save two, Hardik was backtracking while facing the fielder and has to settle for one. Was a short ball to which he'd gotten inside the line and pulled
Back of length around off, pulled to midwicket off the bottom-half of the bat
Cut powerfully, finds cover point. Slightly short on fourth, on the quicker side
Hardik ruins Brar's over with a slog sweep. 90ks ball was a touch too full and on the pads, Pandya cleared the front leg a bit and swivelled hard while slugging it
Slowed down again, 84ks. Length on middle and leg, flicked off the back foot to deep square leg
Gives it more air, SKY tries to drive hard through cover. Inside edges onto pad. Was a full ball on fourth
Flat and fullish on leg, 97ks, whipped to long-on's right
Flat on middle, 89ks, driven to deep cover
Slower yorker on sixth, jammed to cover
Hardik opens the face and gets the bat low to guide it off a three-quarter length to deep third
Bouncer over leg, let go
Return-chance dropped, it was skidding straight at Vyshak, he tried to take it with both hands while decelerating and it popped in front. Was a 138ks fullish ball that was check-driven
Well down leg, Inglis takes two steps and leaps but has no chance. Pace up to 144ks on the length ball

Skied, taken at long-on. Change of line and pace from Vyshak. Cutter was full around sixth, Jacks took a small stride in front and had to reach out with his hands to slash it. Wanted to go off side, but toed it right up. Replays show it was a knuckle ball
Bad ball, overpitched on off. Jacks picks it up with ease. Sails with the wind, well over deep midwicket who was in place
Low, wide full toss beats him for pace. 133ks, zipping over the tramline, Jacks got low and tried to scissor it behind point
Length on fourth, cut well, finds backward point
Bouncer beats the hook, given wide though. MI's hundred is up. Ball landed very short and went over middle and off, SKY got inside and was swivelling. Wanted to go fine
Fuller side of length outside off, opens the face to drive it to backward point's left. Stopped with a slide
Thickish edge to deep third. SKY checks the cover drive as the length ball outside off jumped up
Stirs it to deep third. Length on fourth, 136ks
Makes room and carves it wide of and over mid-off. Took a couple of short steps down too, got it off a length. Bottom-half of the bat but connection's good enough
Top edge off the pull goes over the keeper. Landed very short around leg and finished on off, Jacks tried to play that from the crease
Hard length on off, flicked to deep square leg

Taken at deep third. Tilak's tentative again. He was lunging across to a wide length ball, shaping to slap it, but stopped midway. Ball might've stuck in the pitch, it took a top edge and went straight to Arsdheep. Vyshak's pumped
Zips off the pitch, 137ks which is considerably quicker. Landed around fourth and straightened, Tilak is tentative as he looks to clip it leg side and gets beaten. Big gap between bat and pad
Length on off, worked to long-on
And again, the full ball's wider though. Keeper tumbles right to stop it
Full over the tramline, 124ks, SKY tries to sling it over point. Beaten
Short outside off, 136ks, cut late. Deep third runs across and slides to keep it to two
Floated outside off, he drives to deep cover
Juuust short of the fielder sprinting in from deep midwicket. Tossed up outside off, he sweeps not off the middle. Shashank runs in, but isn't to reach that
Flatter on a length outside off, he pushes back to the bowler

That's a stunner by Wadhera at long-on. My word! Tossed up on the leg stump, rather just outside. Rohit backs away, gives himself room, looking to go over the fielder's head. Ends up finding the bottom-end of the blade as the ball travels to long-on. It seems it would fall short but Wadhera hares in, dives forward and hangs on
Darted in on middle stump, ends up being a full toss which Surya pushes to long-off
Angled in on middle and leg, he clips this to wide long-on

That's Surya's best ever IPL season, and he's crossed 25 for the 14th straight time this IPL. WOWZA! He is in some form. Fuller outside off, he squirts this past point and there is nothing the fielder in the deep can do about it
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he pats this to point
Jamieson over-compensates and gets punished again. Fullish in length outside off, and this time Surya lofts him over mid-off
There's the Surya Supla shot and it goes all the way. Nothing wrong with the delivery. Was a length ball just outside off, he steps across and flays it away over deep square leg
Back of a length ball again just outside off, he pulls to the right of deep square leg but only for a run
Starts off with a back of a length ball outside off that was there to be smashed away. Think Rohit was trying to go too hard there and misses
Floated outside off, he lofts this right off the cue-end of the blade to deep cover
Fuller and well outside off, he chops it and the ball goes over the keeper's head as Rohit calls him through for a run
Angled in on off and middle, he works this to deep midwicket with soft hands. Looks for a second run, but Surya sends him back
Low full toss outside off, he sweeps again but this time straight to deep midwicket
Out comes Surya's sweep as he gets his first four of the night. Floated on the stump, he gets well inside the line and sweeps it well behind square
Tossed up outside off, he unleashes a crunching cover drive but Shashank at deep cover sprints across quickly
Yes, he can. The first over of the innings without a boundary. Slower length ball outside off, he guides it but straight to short third
Play and a miss. Much fuller and well outside off. Surya looks to slice this fine, but can't connect
Shimmies down the track but Vyshak gets this on a good length and on middle as Rohit works this to deep square leg
Crunched, but there is a deep point in place. Was a touch fuller outside off, Surya's timing already looks good this evening
Length ball angling into Surya around off, he defends it with soft hands as the ball ends up in the flap of his pad
Gets some extra bounce on that good length ball just on off. He runs it off the splice down to deep third
Short and wide, Surya cuts it hard but not past backward point
On a length outside off, he unleashes a square drive but straight to deep point.
Good length ball outside off, he guides this to deep third
Gets across looking for a swipe across the line but misses. Was a short of a good length ball on off and middle and he's rapped on the thigh pad.
Ooh, lucky boundary but Surya won't mind. Length ball angling across Surya well outside off. He eyes an uppish drive, but can only manage to squirt it off the outside edge that flies past point
Tests him with a short ball first up but that is down leg. Banged in short at pace, but the line was a touch awry

Straight up and Iyer gobbles it up. Hard length delivery just outside off stump, Rickelton looks for a pull, but the extra bounce of Jansen does the batter in. Ends up spooning it straight up and Iyer takes a simple catch at mid-on
Quicker on a length on leg stump, he works this to deep midwicket
Flatter length ball on off stump, he pushes to long-off
Wide spaces in the deep on the offside and Rohit has four more. Floated outside off, he goes up and over covers
Dumps him over deep midwicket first ball. Flighted outside off stump, Rohit jumps down the track and despite not getting to the pitch takes full toll
Floated on leg stump, he eases this to long-on
Tossed up on middle and leg, he works this to square leg
Excellent short ball to end the over. Banged in short just outside off, he is rushed into the pull and gets beaten. Not often that happens
Backs away but Arshdeep follows him with a slower ball, cramping him for room. Rickelton works this to deep backward square leg
Fetch that! Banged in short on off stump. Rickelton backs away and slams the pull over short midwicket.
Slower length ball outside off stump, he opens the face of his bat and runs it to point
PUMMELED!  Half-volley outside off stump, he stays still and pumps this straight over the bowler's head. That's a short and a half!
Full in length on off stump, Rickelton unleashes a full-blooded straight drive and smacks Arshdeep on the fingers
Too full and Rohit accepts the gift with glee. Half-volley outside off, Rohit stays legside of the ball and lifts it over mid-off.
A swish and a miss. Back of a length ball angling across the batter, who throws his bat at it but only connects at thin air
A wide, this time down leg. Banged in short, testing Rohit's pull early. He went for it but the line was down leg.
Full veering away from Rohit but this one is just outside the tramline and is called a wide. Rohit let that go
Fullish in length outside off, he drives on the up but can't beat extra cover
Looks for a big heave, misses and is hit on the finger as well. Length ball cutting back into Rohit around leg stump. Immediately has a look at his little finger. That would have stung
Length ball on middle and leg, he works this towards short midwicket
On a length on middle, he splices this towards mid-on
Back of a length ball angling away from Rickelton who stands tall and punches this to cover, who is right on the edge of the circle
Lifted up and over and for a one-bounce four. On a length outside off stump, he gets under it and lofts it over mid-on.
On a length outside off, he steps across and pushes towards cover
There is a deep point in place, but he ain't getting anywhere close to that. Short and wide, he frees his arms and slams this past point for his second four
In-dipper on a length on middle and leg, he ticks this towards mid-on
Good length ball outside off, he gets on top of the bounce and pushes towards point
Fuller shaping away from Rickelton outside off, he looks to push it through the offside, and misses
Length ball shaping away from Rickelton outside off. He squirts it off the outer half of the blade to the right of deep point. But Wadhera sprints and saves two
Goes short and Rickelton gets his boundary counter running with a pull. Banged in shoulder-high on leg stump, he gets on top of the bounce and pulls to the deep backward square leg fence
Big booming inswinger and Rickelton was almost done in there. He did not spot that and he drove on the up. Ends up completely miscuing it but thankfully for him, the ball falls short of cover
Not entirely in control but Rickelton is off the mark. Lovely away shape on this length ball just outside off. Rickelton pushes at it, gets a bit of a leading edge but through the covers
Hint of away swing as Arshdeep goes fuller and just outside off stump. Rickelton pings it off the middle of the bat but straight to short cover.
PBKS secure the top-two finish! Finished with a pull over long-on. Not too short, very flat though, Shreyas slapped it with aplomb
Length outside off from around the wicket, beaten on the choppy square drive
Direct hit at the non-striker's from mid-off, batter's in and it deflects to the left to allow the single. Wadhera danced down to get that pace-on ball on the low full toss and drove.
Very very slow from Santner but it's too full. Shreyas dances down to get to the pitch and crunches it inside out over extra. 76ks
Slow on leg, Shreyas premeditates and connects with the paddle. No follow-through, gets it through leg slip
Touch wide and very flat, pulled to long-on. Length ball might've spun in

Lbw turned down, Santner motions for a review. Hardik agrees. Height and line could be issues. Was a shortish ball angling in, beat Inglis' paddle with bat going down to up. Hit just over the knee-roll. It landed just outside off, stuck him in front of middle... and would go on to smash leg actually! Inglis punches his bat in disappointment but gets a lot of applause from team-mates and owners
Teaser but line's wrong. Down leg, the slow length ball goes past the pull
Santner can't follow Inglis despite trying as the batter continued to move while cutting it over extra cover. Length was a touch short, trajectory was flat
95ks, a touch short and angling down leg. Pulled to long leg
142ks. Very low full toss on middle, punched to long-on. That's Bumrah done
Third nailed yorker. On off this time. 137ks. Shreyas is beside the line and jams it to point
Pacy and fullish on off, driven to mid-off's left
Yorker missed this time, Inglis pulls through midwicket. Nearly top of stump high, Inglis stood steadily and wound across to get a one-bounce four
Fourth-stump yorker this time. Pace on again. 143ks. Shreyas jams the bat on it to run it to deep third
Yorker on leg, clipped to midwicket
Makes room again, gets followed by a length ball, punched to long-on
Shortish on off, Shreyas dances down and punches it to the left of long-on for an easy two
Finch's nailing the predictions. Says big shot's coming and Shreyas duly slog sweeps over square leg. Jacks went quick and in at the pads
Makes room and gets followed, pulls it to midwicket
Reverse sweep, Finch called it on air as there was a field change. Full ball was fired down leg
Good shot to a good ball. On a length on off, spins into middle and Inglis uses the pace to paddle it through the leg-slip region
Fired down leg, goes past the attempted pull that Shreyas wanted to get fine. Think Shreyas bluffed making room before getting into the regular stance just before the release
Makes room and slaps the full, slow ball on middle to long-off
Shreyas caught between shots, shaped to go through cover and then got the bat jamming into pad to defend the length ball at the stumps
Tossed up again, fullish outside off, swept to deep midwicket
Change up, much quicker and flatter. 97ks, length on off, Inglis was on the back foot, had to hurry into the full-faced punch back to the bowler
Almost two in two! On the bounce to deep cover. 80ks full ball was wide and Shreyas tried to go over cover. Toed it

He's teased out Priyansh, just 75ks. Was short too and at the stumps, Priyansh had made room and went for a flat-bat hit. Ball spun away to take the bottom-half and went to long-off. A late but necessary opening for MI
Bouncer is swatted from in front of the face. Into the grass, to the left of deep midwicket
Wide and fullish, heaved across to long-on. On the bounce
Full and pace on again, wide too but gets away with it as Priyansh gets beaten on the attempted slash over cover
Another missed yorker, ankle-high full toss is down leg. Glanced fine with ease
Short, slow off the pitch. Pulled from chest height to deep square leg
Misses the yorker, Inglis drives the fourth-stump full toss through cover. Bottom-hand heavy with a full flourish
Hurried and cramped for room but Priyansh goes through with the pull, gets a top edge that sails far over fine leg. Even the Bumrah over finishes with double figures
Yorker on middle and leg, clipped softly to midwicket
Slower one followed by a pacy bouncer. 142ks. Landed around off and finished over leg, Priyansh ducked a bit and tried to hook it with bat above head. Missed it
Small appeal for caught behind from Bumrah, not given. Slower ball was full and angling down leg, went past the flick and took the trouser
Tight single, Bumrah chased to his diagonal left and shied at the non-striker's, missed. Was a hard length ball on the pads that beat the pull and smashed the pad
PBKS keep attacking nonetheless. Bumrah goes full on off and Inglis drives it over cover. Bat face opened on impact but it cleared the fielder
Pulled, gets it between long-on and deep midwicket. Not that short, Priyansh just stood upright and picked it up to bring up his fifty
Wide and it's slashed over cover. The length ball went away with the angle. Was an offcutter but it neither stuck in the pitch nor deviated sideways
Length on leg, clipped through square leg to bring up Inglis' first fifty of the season
Yorker down leg, goes past the attempted flick. 137ks
Full and wide, driven to deep point
Inglis makes room while charging, gets cramped for room. The length ball zipped in towards top of leg. Under-edged cut goes to deep fine leg
No, but it nearly gets the wicket. Priyansh drove the full ball with power, got it to long-off on the bounce
Yorker on middle, jammed to long-on. 129ks
Very wide and slow, the fullish ball is let go
Yorker on the pads, clipped through midwicket

Another reverse sweep over short third, this is off a length. The slower one was on off, Inglis - with feet spread -  was inside the line and followed through with the shot fully. Had to wait a second after getting in position too
Overpitched and it's driven beautifully. Straight of mid-off

Inglis turns into a bridge and reverse sweeps a low fully over short third. Hopped to get the feet wide apart and lunged low, the ball was going away from him and yet he managed to get the timing right
Near yorker on middle, Priyansh slides leg side and drives to deep point. 127ks
Yorker on off, dug back to the bowler

A direct hit and Arya was a goner. Full on off stump, he pushes to mid-off and sets off. Only to realise that he's hit the ball too hard. Arya is meanwhile halfway down the track and has given up. Hardik misses
On a length on middle and leg, he works this to short midwicket
SMOKED! Rare half-volley from Bumrah outside off and Inglis thumps this on the up through covers
Almost gets his man. On a length just around off stump. He looks to work this to the on-side, gets a big leading edge that almost goes all the wat to deep third.
Yorker on middle stump, he opens the face of the bat and guides to point
Flatter outside off, he cuts this to backward point.
Knee-high full toss on leg stump, he dinks this past short midwicket for a run
Slows this up on a length on middle and leg, he works this behind square
Tossed up well outside off stump and past the tramline. Called a wide
Has he found the gap again? Oh, he has. Dragged down turning away from Inglis outside off. He stays low in his stance and pulls with elan to the right of mid-on
Fullish in length on middle stump, he eases this to long-on
Marginally short outside off, Inglis hangs back and punches to deep extra cover
On a length on off stump, he presents the full face of the bat and punches past his partner who has to quickly get out of the way
Good length ball on middle and leg, he works this to the right of deep backward square leg and some excellent running gets Inglis two
Ramped fine, ramped for six. Hardik getting a taste of his own medicine. Banged in short outside off, but with the short third in, it's not the most ideal lengths. Inglis effortlessly gets six
Fullish in length outside off, he drills the drive but straight to deep cover
Banged in short outside off, he looks to ramp this fine, but misses. Was it too high? Nope, one bouncer for the over, says the umpire.
SCREAMED through covers. On a good length outside off, he stays still and pumps this over extra cover
Fuller and flatter outside off, he squirts it off the bottom edge past short third for a couple of runs
Short and wide well outside off, Inglis can't reach it. Called a wide

Catch it is the cry, but the wind is blowing that side and it is also the shorter side. All these factors combine in getting Inglis a six. Marginally short outside off, he goes back and pulls. The ball goes high into the night sky but has enough legs to clear deep midwicket
Floats this up gently well outside off. Inglis eyes a reverse sweep and misses once more
Pushed quicker just outside off, he cuts this to point
Pushed quicker on middle and leg, he flat bats this to deep square leg

Misfield and Arya gets four. Marginally short on middle and keg, he pulls to the right of Tilak at deep backward square leg. He dives, slips and jams his knee on the ground. In all this, the ball slips through.
Fuller in length outside off, he toe-ends this to mid-on for a quick run
Easy pickings and Arya has four more. 120kph knuckle ball halfway down the pitch on Arya's hips. He helps this over short fine leg
Fuller in length on off, he drives to mid-off for a quick single
Fuller outside off, Inglis looks for a reverse laps, but fails to connect
PUMPED! Dragged down by Chahar at 119kph outside off and Inglis thumps this for a 76m six over deep midwicket
Gets the ball to nip back into Inglis from a good length. He meets it around off stumps and just about defends
Just a run off the first Bumrah over, and that too comes off the edge. Length ball outside off, he was aiming for midwicket, the ball took his edge and went to deep third
Slower dipping yorker on off stump. Offcutter and Inglis somehow keeps it out
Back of a length ball just around off stump, he opens the face of the bat and guides to point
On-pace fuller length ball shaping away from Inglis well outside off. He goes after it, and misses

Ashwani makes amends and Prabhsimran's tough innings ends. Bumrah has a wicket second ball. Slower offcutter outside off at 120.1kph. He jumps down the track looking to go straight down. Gets a thick outside edge as the ball flies to deep third. Ashwani sprints forward, dives and takes a good catch
And almost has a wicket first ball. Hard length to start off around off stump. Prabhsimran looks to go up over, ends up splicing it towards mid-on. Boult dives but can't reach it
What timing! Slower knuckle ball again outside off, he punches this almost effortlessly and finds the gap in the covers region
Length ball outside off, was the slower one again. He plays it uppishly but just short of cover point
Slower delivery goes awry. Was very full and very wide outside off

That's gone high... very high and Ashwani shells it around the midwicket short area. Slower delivery on a length on off, Prabhsimran hits it off the middle but straight up. The ball swirls around in the air, and Ashwani who never looked settled under it, fails to hang on
CLUBBED! Back of a length ball outside off, he smashes it up and over extra cover
Knuckle ball outside off, Prabhsimran was looking for a scoop again but misses. Rickelton takes evasive action. Arya was searching for a bye, is sent back
Six of the first ball! Length ball on off stump, rather just outside. Prabhsimran steps right across, bends down on one knee and scoops it over short fine leg
Oh, what fielding from Surya. He's scoring the runs, he's saving the boundaries. On a length outside off, Arya pumps the cover drive, but Surya dives full-length to his right and saves four.
On a good length outside off, he opens the face of the blade and guides to short third
Short of a good length ball on middle stump, Arya works this effortlessly through midwicket for a couple of runs
Length ball swinging back into Prabhsimran, who hoicks this away to deep backward square leg
Sharp length ball on leg stump, he misses the flick and is rapped on the pad. Was sliding down leg
Throws his hands at it, gets four more. On a length shaping away from Arya outside off. He gets a thick outside edge that flies over short third

A maiden over in the powerplay. Lovely stuff from Chahar.  On a length on off, he is bowling within himself but finding his length. He can only defend back to the bowler. Chahar is going off the field as well.
Biiig swing and a miss. That's what four dot balls can do. Good length ball shaping away from Prabhsimran who jumps down, has a heave and misses
Another dot! Floats this fuller in length on off stump at just 117.3kph. Prabhsimran prods forward and pushes to cover
A third straight dot. Short and wide again, he pats this to backward point once more
Short and wide outside the tramline, he bunts this to backward point. Chahar is not running at full tilt.
Excellent stop inside the circle. Pitched up just around off stump, he steps forward and laces a straight drive. Mid-off  dives this his right and saves four

Oh, Boult was so close to striking once more in the first over. Uppish but in the gap. Good length ball swinging away from Arya outside off. He doesn't move his feet at all and just pushes it. Finds the gap between point and cover point
Length on off stump, he pushes to mid-off and sets off. Good single
Loud appeal for lbw, but think that was going down leg. Get the ball full and to swing into Prabhsimran. But that started too straight and even as it hit the batter's boot it was sliding down
On a length shaping away from Prabhsimran outside off. He dabs it to backward point
Edgy but safe. Back of a length ball shaping away from Arya who flirts at it and edges it uppishly wide of point
Oh, my word! What a shot to begin the chase. Back of a length ball outside off, he steps forward and laces this up and over covers with minimum of fuss
